# WOWOHCOOL
> WOWOHCOOL (Dong Yi Technology Co., Ltd) — ISO 9001-certified manufacturer of GaN chargers, power banks, and Qi2 wireless chargers since 2013, Shenzhen, Guangdong, China. We publish first-party OEM/ODM sourcing, factory-verification, and certification guidance for importers across 6 languages.
